scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && cp -R public/. dist/ && PYTHONPATH=src "${DCT_PYTHON:-python3}" -m dct.cli publish --out dist --site-url "${GT_SITE:-https://defunctcompanies.com}" --site-name "Defunct Company Tracker" && find dist -name '._*' -delete
scripts.build:demo: mkdir -p dist && cp -R public/. dist/ && PYTHONPATH=src "${DCT_PYTHON:-python3}" -m dct.cli demo --out dist --site-url "${GT_SITE:-https://defunctcompanies.com}" --site-name "Defunct Company Tracker" && find dist -name '._*' -delete
